component.name: Color Contrast Checker
component.summary: Check color contrast against WCAG 2.1 with a screen eyedropper

description.p: Check foreground and background color pairs against the WCAG 2.1 contrast requirements for normal text, large text and user interface components, at levels AA and AAA.
Pick colors from anywhere on the screen, adjust opacity and lightness, and get the closest accessible alternatives that keep your hue.
